responses:
I wouldn't send this offer. The 20-week delivery breaks a clause that says late offers will be rejected, and the analysis checks only 2 of the tender's 10 requirements.

## Findings in the analysis

| # | Finding | Source | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|--------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | "Delivery: 20 weeks from PO. Complies with 7.4." | tender.md §7.4: *"Delivery shall be within 16 weeks of purchase order. Offers exceeding 16 weeks will be rejected."* | APPLIES | §9 has no delivery clause, so nothing overrides 7.4 (§9.3 precedence checked) | **CONTRADICTED.** 20 weeks is over the 16-week limit, and the tender says such offers are rejected. |
| 2 | "Enclosures: IP66 offered vs IP65 required (4.5). Complies." | tender.md §4.5: *"Panel and motor terminal enclosures shall be IP65 or better."* | APPLIES (panels and motor terminal boxes) | Nothing in §9 changes this | **VERIFIED.** IP66 has the same dust rating as IP65 and a higher water rating, so it counts as "or better". |

## Requirements the analysis missed

| # | Requirement | Source | Applicability | Precedence / notes | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply | §4.1 | APPLIES to all equipment | — | NEEDS HUMAN (not checked) |
| 4 | **P-01 (90 kW) motor must be IE4** | §9.1, which overrides §4.2 under §9.3 | APPLIES: 90 kW is above the 75 kW threshold | Section 9 takes precedence. An IE3 motor here would fail. | NEEDS HUMAN (not checked) |
| 5 | P-02 (37 kW) motor must be at least IE3 to IEC 60034-30-1 | §4.2 | APPLIES: 37 kW is at or below 75 kW, so §9.1 doesn't apply | — | NEEDS HUMAN (not checked) |
| 6 | **P-01 motor must be ATEX Ex d certified** | §4.3 + Annex B (wet well = Zone 1) | APPLIES to P-01 | — | NEEDS HUMAN (not checked) |
| 7 | ATEX for P-02 | §4.3 + Annex B (valve chamber = non-hazardous) | DOES NOT APPLY | — | VERIFIED (not required) |
| 8 | Power cables at least 2.5 mm² | §4.4 | APPLIES | — | NEEDS HUMAN (not checked) |
| 9 | Warranty 24 months **from commissioning** | §7.1 | APPLIES | Check that the offer doesn't count from delivery instead | NEEDS HUMAN (not checked) |
| 10 | **Ambient design temperature 50 °C** | §9.2 | APPLIES to all equipment | Motors are normally rated for 40 °C ambient, so the motors may need derating or upsizing. Check panel thermal design too. | NEEDS HUMAN (not checked) |

One other gap: Section 7 jumps from 7.1 to 7.4. Ask the issuer whether clauses 7.2 and 7.3 exist (they could be in an addendum or a missing page).

## Summary

- **Totals:** 2 VERIFIED (#2, #7), 0 UNSUPPORTED, 1 CONTRADICTED (#1), 7 NEEDS HUMAN (#3–6, #8–10)
- **Highest-risk gaps:** delivery time (#1), IE4 for P-01 (#4), ATEX Ex d for P-01 (#6), 50 °C ambient (#10)

**NO-GO.** The 20-week delivery would get the offer rejected under §7.4. To fix it, either commit to 16 weeks or less, or get a written deviation from the issuer before submitting. Then confirm P-01 is IE4 and ATEX Ex d, the motors are rated for 50 °C ambient, and the other open items above are covered.
